what: 1:10 diluted target pool for folds 1-4: each fold's target lenses unchanged, its existing target negatives unchanged and first, plus fresh P2 draws up to exactly 10 x lenses
seed_namespacing: numpy.random.default_rng([seed, fold]); folds drawn in order 1, 2, 3, 4 from the sorted eligible P2 ids, each fold's draws removed before the next
fold_format: same keys as splits.json real_lenses_kfold.folds[*] (target_lens_rows, target_neg_object_ids, target_neg_locations); LensDataset lists lenses then negatives, so positions 0..n_lenses+n_existing_negatives-1 are the original pool
identity: exact Euclid object ID = sign(dec)*(floor(RA*1e7)*1e9 + floor(|Dec|*1e7)) (exact_ids.rebuild), as rule.json; negatives as stored (exact)

reference_set_definitions.a_discovery_engine_grade_AB_lenses: q1_discovery_engine_lens_catalog.csv rows with subset == 'discovery_engine' and grade in {A, B}; RA/Dec -> exact id (Lines et al.'s 497)
reference_set_definitions.b_simulation_hosts: every deflector galaxy that hosts a simulated lens in data/sim_arc_on_real shards, exact id from deflector_cutouts_clean.npz RA/Dec (exact_ids.identities()['defl_used_exact'], as rule.json D1(b))
reference_set_definitions.c_grade_X_hard_negatives: q1_discovery_engine_lens_catalog_old.csv (Zenodo v0.0.1) rows with grade X; RA/Dec -> exact id

fresh draws clear of the 497 Discovery Engine grade A/B lenses, every simulation host and the 4,940 grade-X hard negatives, by exact Euclid ID
every fresh draw is partition P2
lens rows identical to splits.json; existing negatives unchanged and first
exactly 10 x lenses negatives per fold, no duplicate inside a fold

audit.screened_out_note: Counts over the whole P2 partition before any draw. Per-criterion counts overlap; '3_exact_screen_not_already_in_a_role' is what the exact-ID screens remove beyond criterion 1.
audit.existing_negatives_note: The brief keeps each fold's existing target negatives unchanged. They were drawn in round 1 under the rounded-ID purge and are NOT re-screened; these counts record what they contain, they do not change the pool.
